entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed. It's not working at all.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's definitely a fault. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I try. I followed all the instructions. I honestly think the whole thing is broken. For what I paid, I really expected better. I feel like it must be defective.
I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the trouble you're having. Let me pull up your account. Can I get your name and order number, please?

Yes, the name is Sarah Miller. The order number is... VF-886-2150. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I saved up for this. I was so excited, and now I just feel let down. I really needed this money if it wasn't going to work right.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order right here. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th, so about 34 days ago. I'm just going to check our return policy for you. One moment.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've just reviewed our policy, and it looks like all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Since you're well within that 90-day timeframe, I can absolutely go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you. I'm very sorry again that the band was defective.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. I really appreciate you doing that for me.

Of course. It's the least we can do. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Please package the VeloBand Pulse in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be issued as soon as our warehouse receives it.
That's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a much better rest of your day.
